cohort: Medically stable preterm infants born <33 weeks' gestation (n=46) were randomized to receive diaper changes at a frequency of every 3-hours (n=20) or every 6-hours (n=26).
finding: Alpha-diversity of the skin microbiota increased over time but did not differ significantly between the 3-hour and 6-hour diaper change groups, although relative abundances of multiple genera did differ over time.
mod_finding: Delivery mode accounted for minor proportions of the variation in microbiota community structure.
followup_time: from a median postnatal age of 44 days through hospital discharge
